reviews.title: Great starter card
reviews.comment: This card is great if you're just playing light games and only wanting 1080p will run most indie titles on high setting and even some AA games at high settings as well. I would recommend this card to anyone just starting out building a gaming PC

reviews.title: Works exactly as expected
reviews.comment: As I dual-boot Linux and Windows and play games in both that are moderately challenging in terms of graphics, I knew what I was going to need in regards a GFX card both in terms of its capabilities and support across operating systems. I was also limited to a 2 fan card due to my computer's small size - I'm not a gamerboi, just an old man on a fixed income who games. This card provides precisely what I need in terms of power, in size and in budget.  I have several Asus products, have had others in the past and am well-pleased with the quality of their products. This is no exception. While it's up to you to determine your exact graphics needs, if a 1660ti fits them, this card should suit you well.
reviews.author: ahmrahtcheer

reviews.title: Great item...
reviews.comment: No issues, works great. Runs everything we want it to and so far it does pretty well in 1080p or 1440. My wife really just uses it for fortnite but still. Haven't had any game breaking bugs like my xtx.
